name: Decline Sit-Up
instructions: Lie on a decline bench, head end lower than your feet, with your feet hooked securely under the pads and your arms crossed on your chest.
Curl your torso up by flexing your spine until your chest moves toward your thighs.
Lower back down slowly until your shoulders almost touch the bench.
The decline makes this harder than a flat sit-up. Keep your neck relaxed and avoid yanking yourself up with momentum.
image_prompt_scene: Lying on a decline bench with the feet hooked under the pads and arms crossed on the chest.
